definition: with a lot of wind blowing
description: A young woman stands in the pouring rain on a wet village street wearing a clear plastic rain jacket, grinning at the camera. She then appears in a bright yellow raincoat, doing up the front and pulling the hood up over her hair while rain falls around her. In the last part she stands on a seafront promenade in an orange raincoat and spotted rubber boots, grey sky above, big waves smashing over the railing behind her, and she spreads her arms wide as the wind and spray hit her.

en.question: What is she doing by the sea?

de.answer: Sie breitet die Arme weit aus.
de.question: Was macht sie am Meer?

es.answer: Está abriendo los brazos de par en par.
